name: Chuoi ngu
summary: A very small banana that ripens to a silky yellow, fragrant and lightly sweet. The Đại Hoàng fruit is thin-skinned and firm, not mushy, and is kept for offerings and for Tết.
origin: The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 list chuối ngự as a Nam Định gift, with no village. Dân Việt on 16 April 2014 says Nam Định, also with no village. Dân Việt on 15 April 2025 says Đại Hoàng, xã Hòa Hậu, huyện Lý Nhân, and writes tỉnh Hải Nam in one sentence and tỉnh Hà Nam in the next.
texture: On 16 April 2014 the fruit is very small, ripe to a silk yellow, fragrant, and lightly sweet. On 15 April 2025 the Đại Hoàng fruit is small, thin-skinned, bright yellow, round, without ridges, yellow and firm inside, and not mushy. The same article says some people count three kinds, ngự trắng, ngự trâu, and ngự mít, and that people in Đại Hoàng say they grow only one, which they call Ngự vàng. Both counts stay.
where: The city gift list names no village. Đại Hoàng is Hòa Hậu and Tiến Thắng in Lý Nhân, printed once as Hải Nam and once as Hà Nam.
seoTitle: Chuoi ngu — the small banana named by a king
seoDescription: A very small, fragrant, lightly sweet banana on the Nam Định gift list, and chuối Ngự Đại Hoàng in Lý Nhân.
